about_short_description.short_description: Qashio is a financial technology company that provides corporate cards and business expense management software.

product.name: Qashio Spend
product.description: A corporate expense management platform for issuing cards, tracking transactions, applying spending controls, automating expense processes, and integrating finance data with accounting and ERP systems.

product.name: Qashio Corporate Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual prepaid Visa corporate cards that businesses can issue to employees, configure with spending limits and controls, and monitor through a centralized expense platform.

product.name: Qashio Points
product.description: A business spending rewards program that awards points on eligible Qashio card transactions and allows companies to redeem them for travel miles, cashback, partner rewards, and other benefits.

product.name: Qashio Accounts
product.description: An accounts payable management service for organizing vendor payments, improving payment workflows, managing cash flow, and maintaining supplier relationships.

product.name: Qashio Corporate Travel
product.description: A corporate travel management solution for coordinating business travel bookings, travel-related payments, and associated expense visibility in one platform.

product.name: Qashio for Travel
product.description: A travel payments and expense solution for travel agencies, booking platforms, and other travel businesses that need controlled payment methods and transaction visibility.
